{{Quote|So yes, I ordered the retreat. Even then, only half of us survived. There's no stopping them. Why die trying?|Dannis Veriga, during their court-martial|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Dannis Veriga''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3636 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> the [[Eternal Empire]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|invaded]] the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and Veriga was in charge of the Republic forces tasked with [[Defense of Alderaan|protecting]]<ref name="Codex" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Alderaan">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alderaan}}</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] when the Eternal Empire's [[Eternal Fleet]] arrived in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]].<ref name="Codex" />

After the Eternal Fleet dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in a wall of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] moving synchronously, Veriga's forces were quickly overwhelmed and were unable to make any significant dent in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], so Veriga ordered a retreat&mdash;although that order ultimately only managed to save half of the Republic forces at Alderaan. The admiral was [[Court-martial/Legends|court-martialed]] in the aftermath for abandoning the planet, and during the trial expressed a belief that dying in an effort to stop the Eternal Empire would be pointless.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dannis Veriga was mentioned in the "Eternal Fleet: Combat" Codex entry in Chapter XV of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
